text:
sam: Quick follow-up from the postmortem thread. We need explicit owners, measurable SLOs, and a small verification plan for: auto-rollback, flag defaults, and blast-radius tests. Keep it short.

irene: I'll take auto-rollback. Plan: two-step rollback = soft-reroute then full revert. Detection+soft-reroute goal <= 90s, full revert <= 4m. ETA: 10 business days. Will add a design doc + controller unit tests.

carlos: I'll own flag governance and migration. New rule: flags that touch routing/model selection require risk_tier + default_off (default_off=true). I'll add a validator to registry and a migration script to mark risky flags. ETA: 5 days.

infra-bot: Created tickets: <https://tracker/redwood/INF-5101|INF-5101> rollback (irene); <https://tracker/redwood/INF-5102|INF-5102> flag-validator (carlos); <https://tracker/redwood/INF-5103|INF-5103> blast-radius harness (sre-jen).

sre-jen: I'll build the blast-radius harness. Small chaos runner that replays sanitized incident traffic and verifies rollback timing and order. Run in staging + canary. ETA: 7 days. Need one-off creds for canary cluster (infra).

irene: Proposed Prom rule for rollback candidate:
```
alert: RolloutSafetyTrip
expr: (increase(request_errors_total[5m]) / increase(requests_total[5m]) > 0.006) or (avg_over_time(latency_p50[5m]) > 1.8 * baseline_p50)
for: 2m
labels: {severity: "critical"}
```
This will feed into rollout-operator to start soft-reroute and notify oncall.

carlos: Flag metadata example I'll require in the registry:
```
flag_name: model_selector_v2
owners: ["carlos"]
risk_tier: high
default_off: true
rollout_strategy: staged
```
Validator will block default_off:false for high/critical without an approval ticket.

sre-jen: For the harness, test plan: 1) inject 2x error rate for 5m, 2) confirm soft-reroute at <=90s, 3) confirm full revert <=4m, 4) verify no regressions for false positives in 5 runs. I'll attach sanitized trace to INF-5103.

sam: Please add explicit metrics to the tickets: detection latency, time-to-soft-reroute, time-to-full-revert, and allowed false-positive rate. Owners, put ETAs in the tickets by EOD tomorrow.

carlos: I'll add migration notes to INF-5102 listing existing flags that will be auto-marked default_off and an exceptions workflow.

irene: I'll include a short oncall runbook snippet in INF-5101: how to force soft-reroute, where to find last-stable artifact, and emergency manual revert commands.

sam: OK weekly 15m check-in Fri 09:00. If infra access is blocking any testing, ping infra@ and me. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
